title: Under a flat local map inducing an isomorphism on residue fields the injective hulls agree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat local homomorphism inducing an isomorphism on residue fields the injective hull of the residue field of the source is also the injective hull over the target (author lemma at source lines 1060-1066, label lemma-compare). The proof (source lines 1068-1080) identifies the residue fields, uses flatness to make the target hull injective over the source, extends the identification to a map between the hulls and shows it is an isomorphism through the criterion on quotients by powers of the maximal ideal (proof lines 1068-1079). The comparison through the power quotients is the substance. H3.
